messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT fired: runtime-inference-error-rate > 5% for 3m (cluster: us-west-2). Incident link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-089
micah: seeing it, jumping in. scaling group is at 60% CPU but error rate is spiking.
tess: thanks. can you plumb in the runbook? link?
micah: runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/inference-errors - starting with canary rollback to tagged model v2.1.3 and increasing max replicas by +2 for realtime pool.
jordan: I can do the rollback, hold on. past incidents looked like bad quantization artifacts after rolling new model.
micah: confirm: autoscaler did not kick fast enough, we want to push a manual scale while we investigate. doing `kubectl scale deployment/realtime-pool --replicas=18 -n prod`
infra-ci-bot: executed: kubectl scale deployment/realtime-pool --replicas=18 -n prod (return: success)
micah: dropping a quick log check: `kubectl logs -l app=realtime -n prod | grep -i error | head` shows a lot of `kv-cache miss` followed by `decode failed` from gpu-worker-7.
riyad: rolling model back now to v2.1.3 to rule out model change. Jordan, ping me when you start.
jordan: rollback started, pushing new image tag v2.1.3 -> queued on 6 pods, rolling update in progress.
tess: customer impact note: we have two active customers hitting high latency/timeouts; product is aware, adding to incident page.
micah: status update: error-rate down to 1.2% after rollback and scale. keeping watch for 15m.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-089 status: mitigation applied, observers monitoring. Severity: P2.
micah: quick blameless note: this escalated because alert fired as P1 page. the underlying signal was noisy and model deploys bump it frequently. we need to tune the alert to reduce pager noise and only page for real customer-impacting failures.
tess: agreed. propose: change rule `runtime-inference-error-rate > 5% for 3m` -> `> 8% for 5m` for pages; leave a ticket-level alert at 5%/3m. Also add a requirement that total request volume > 1000rps before paging so low-traffic flaps don't page.
riyad: also suggest adding a dedupe window in the alert manager so we don't page reduplicatively during rolling updates. current behavior pages every pod failure and duplicates.
jordan: +1. We should also route the paged incidents to #eng-oncall and the ticketable alerts to #eng-sre. Current mapping sends both to #eng-oncall which is noisy.
micah: another ask: dashboard. The existing infra/grafana panel aggregates errors across models; it'd be useful to have a per-model error-rate panel and a heatmap for sequence-length vs error-type. That will help root cause faster.
tess: I'll open a post-incident task list in our incident tracker. Minimal proposed action items:
- change paging threshold (pages) to `error_rate > 8% for 5m && request_rate > 1000`
- create ticket-only alert at `>5% for 3m`
- add dedupe window 10m in alertmanager for inference alerts
- update routing: pages -> #eng-oncall, tickets -> #eng-sre, and create escalation to #infra-urgent for cross-region outages
- add new grafana panels: per-model error rate and kv-cache hit/miss ratio
- bake these as an RFC so security/enterprise teams can review for Private deployments

I'll paste a draft alert policy snippet:```yaml
- alert: RuntimeInferenceErrorRate_PAGER
  expr: |
    sum(rate(inference_errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(inference_requests_total[5m])) * 100 > 8
    and sum(rate(inference_requests_total[5m])) > 1000
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Inference error rate >8% (paged)"

- alert: RuntimeInferenceErrorRate_TICKET
  expr: |
    sum(rate(inference_errors_total[3m])) / sum(rate(inference_requests_total[3m])) * 100 > 5
  labels:
    severity: ticket
  annotations:
    summary: "Inference error rate >5% (ticket)"
```
micah: nice, add a `team: runtime` label so routing rules can use it to split to product/infra oncall.
riyad: for escalation rules, propose: page->30m wait, then escalate to infra-urgent if still present; also escalate to backup oncall after 15m with a DM.
jordan: will prepare the Grafana panel JSON for per-model view, will attach in the ticket. quick draft: query `sum by (model) (rate(inference_errors_total[5m])) / sum by (model) (rate(inference_requests_total[5m])) * 100`
tess: I'm going to schedule a quick ad-hoc postmortem sync 30m after incident is fully closed. Invite: @micah @jordan @riyad @product-ops.
micah: to capture timeline, adding a short incident summary to the page: cause: model rollout + autoscaler lag + noisy error signal -> mitigation: rollback + scale; follow ups: alert tuning + dashboard + routing changes.
incident-bot: INC-2026-089 resolved by mitigation at 1798765422, status: monitoring.
micah: thanks everyone. I'll update the ops-runbook with explicit guidance on paging thresholds and add a pointer to the RFC draft. :thumbsup:
tess: assigning follow-ups: #INC-2026-089-FU in task tracker. I'll own the alert policy PR.
riyad: PR review offer: I'll review the alertmanager/routing changes after lunch.
jordan: dropping the grafana draft link when ready. good catch on dedupe window.
micah: handoff to night oncall @tess in ~45m. If anything spikes after that, escalate per the new draft rules. Good job team.
